evidence_basis.used_for: Primary source lead: direct permission to vent more.
Owned send-behavior support for 'too much' being held gently: 40.15 shares per 1k reach.
Owned listening support: 27.04 shares per 1k reach.
Secondary source engines: ordinary care phrases and ordinary things.

candidates.title: Please Vent More
candidates.exact_first_slide_text: please vent more. i don't want the short version.
candidates.one_line_concept: One partner asks for the long, repetitive, supposedly annoying version of the other person's vent.
candidates.source_engine: DZS2GuipLku source lead plus owned DYJpjt9CQYY/DY4tGrQCXRA support.
candidates.first_frame_visual: Aachu mid-rant in a quiet room; Zuv fully turned toward her, phone face-down, not solving or scrolling.
mini_arc: please vent more. i don't want the short version.
tell me the unnecessary details also.
who said what. what face they made. where you went quiet.
you always say 'sorry, too much' right before the real thing comes out.
no. say the rest.
candidates.payoff_frame: Aachu softens because Zuv wants the rest of the story, not because he fixed anything.
candidates.share_trigger: Send to the person who lets you repeat the same detail without making you feel like a burden.

candidates.title: He Said I Love You All Day
candidates.exact_first_slide_text: he has said i love you all day. just not like that.
candidates.one_line_concept: Practical partner phrases become the hidden love confession.
candidates.source_engine: DZTTSUBEaRr ordinary care phrases as love.
candidates.first_frame_visual: Aachu at the doorway reading a reach-home text while Zuv pretends to be casual.
mini_arc: he has said i love you all day. just not like that.
'take my jacket. you will say no and then shiver.'
'eat first. fight with me after.'
'send me a photo of the cab number.'
some people say it by checking if you got home.
candidates.payoff_frame: The phone glow on Aachu's face after the one-word check-in.
candidates.share_trigger: Send to the practical partner who never says it dramatically.

candidates.title: The Boring Details
candidates.exact_first_slide_text: i like the boring details of you.
candidates.one_line_concept: The intimate thing is noticing the private habits nobody else would care about.
candidates.source_engine: Owned DY_t4Dek0pq observational intimacy plus DYG9a-FEuBQ ordinary-things source.
candidates.first_frame_visual: Aachu checks the door twice while Zuv notices without teasing.
mini_arc: i like the boring details of you.
how you check the door twice.
how your voice changes when you are sleepy.
how you think none of this matters.
it matters to me.
candidates.payoff_frame: A tiny everyday action is seen by someone who has been paying attention.
candidates.share_trigger: Send as 'you are weird and I love knowing this about you.'

candidates.title: Nothing Happened Means
candidates.one_line_concept: After a fight, one partner understands the hidden instruction inside 'nothing happened.'
candidates.first_frame_visual: Aachu turned partly away on the bed; Zuv sits nearby without crowding her.
mini_arc: he knows what 'nothing happened' means.
it means do not ask loudly.
it means sit here, but do not make it a scene.
it means i am angry, not alone.
just a little closer.
candidates.payoff_frame: A tiny sleeve-grab replaces a full apology speech.
candidates.share_trigger: Send after a fight when direct softness is still too much.
